frameworks.name: 認知行為理論與認知重塑 (CBT & Cognitive Reframing)
core_concepts: 自動化負向思考 (Automatic Negative Thoughts, ANTs)
frameworks.application_in_coaching: 協助客戶看見「情境、自動化想法、情緒、行為」的分離，跳脫過度反芻與思緒反轉。
frameworks.reference_citation: Beck, A. T. (1979). Cognitive Therapy of Depression. Guilford Press.

frameworks.name: 接納承諾治療與心理彈性 (ACT & Psychological Flexibility)
frameworks.application_in_coaching: 不再與糾結的想法對抗，而是退一步觀察想法，帶著不確定感朝向個人核心價值採取微小行動。
frameworks.reference_citation: Hayes, S. C., Strosahl, K. D., & Wilson, K. G. (2011). Acceptance and Commitment Therapy: The Process and Practice of Mindful Change. Guilford Press.

frameworks.name: 高敏感與感覺處理敏感性 (Sensory Processing Sensitivity, SPS)
core_concepts: DOES 模型 (深度處理 Depth of processing, 容易過度刺激 Overstimulation, 情緒反應性與同理心 Emotional reactivity/Empathy, 敏銳察覺細節 Sensing the subtle)
神經系統調節與過度負荷保護
frameworks.application_in_coaching: 協助高敏感族群停止將敏感視為缺陷，看見大腦處理模式的優勢，並設立環境降噪與能量保護邊界。
frameworks.reference_citation: Aron, E. N., & Aron, A. (1997). Sensory-processing sensitivity and its relation to introversion and emotionality. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 73(2), 345–368.

frameworks.name: 博溫家庭系統與人際分化 (Bowen Family Systems & Differentiation)
core_concepts: 過度負責與低度負責模式 (Over-functioning / Under-functioning)
人際邊界 (Boundaries) 與討好循環
frameworks.application_in_coaching: 辨識出「別人的情緒不是我的責任」，在緊密關係中守住自我邊界，停止拯救者模式與耗竭後怨懟。
frameworks.reference_citation: Bowen, M. (1978). Family Therapy in Clinical Practice. Jason Aronson.

frameworks.name: 自我決定論 (Self-Determination Theory, SDT)
core_concepts: 三種基本心理需求 (自主感 Autonomy, 勝任感 Competence, 歸屬感 Relatedness)
內在動機 vs 內化外在動機
無力感與心理滿足循環
frameworks.application_in_coaching: 探索目標背後的真正動力是出於「我想要」還是「社會或他人認為我應該」，重建自主掌握感。
frameworks.reference_citation: Deci, E. L., & Ryan, R. M. (2000). The 'what' and 'why' of goal pursuits: Human needs and the self-determination of behavior. Psychological Inquiry, 11(4), 227-268.

frameworks.name: 正向心理學 PERMA 幸福模型與品格優勢
core_concepts: PERMA (正向情緒 Positive Emotions, 全心投入 Engagement, 正向人際 Relationships, 生命意義 Meaning, 成就感 Accomplishment)
frameworks.application_in_coaching: 著重在「如何讓健康的個體更蓬勃發展 (Flourishing)」，設計微小勝任感實驗，積累自信證據。
frameworks.reference_citation: Seligman, M. E. P. (2011). Flourish: A Visionary New Understanding of Happiness and Well-being. Free Press.

frameworks.name: 多迷走神經理論與自律神經調節 (Polyvagal Theory)
core_concepts: 腹側迷走神經 (安全與連結狀態 Safe & Social)
交感神經 (戰或逃 Fight or Flight / 焦慮內耗)
背側迷走神經 (凍結與當機 Freeze / 耗竭離線)
frameworks.application_in_coaching: 理解身心卡關並非意志力薄弱，而是神經系統正在保護自己；先重拾安全感，再啟動理性思考與行動。
frameworks.reference_citation: Porges, S. W. (2011). The Polyvagal Theory: Neurophysiological Foundations of Emotions, Attachment, Communication, and Self-regulation. W. W. Norton & Company.
